description: Golden RAG Triad benchmark: 15 cases against the electronics lab report (benchmark_documents.electronics_labs, DOCX). Block ranges in expected_citations refer to that document's paragraphs (1-based). Categories: direct_fact, multi_chunk, unanswerable, citation_integrity. Unanswerable cases verify the retrieval gate + refusal path; citation_integrity cases verify the pipeline cites the block ranges that actually contain the answer.
